snippet.title: Sponge Bridges | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5163770/Sponge_Bridges/
Support us on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/alungames/sponge-bridges-a-deep-survival-game-of-delivery/
Official website: 
https://spongebridges.com/

This Is an Entire Post-Apocalyptic World
Nothing in this world is merely decoration.
An enormous variety of monsters · items · world elements · buildings
A vast seed-generated world.
Find towns, enter buildings, climb onto rooftops, and descend underground.
Meet all kinds of people in different places, and keep getting swept into new troubles and choices along the way.
